summary: Fixes joinURL in ufo so path segments go before the query string and hash, e.g. "/api?v=2" + "users" gives "/api/users?v=2". Patched with new tests, but some still fail.
narrative: The owner asked for joinURL to put new path segments before the query and hash, with tests. The agent found that joinURL appends to the raw base string, and noted withTrailingSlash already has query- and fragment-aware slash logic. It patched joinURL and added five query/hash test cases. The vitest run reported 5 failures out of 55. The agent traced these to joinRelativeURL, which treats ? and # as ordinary path characters. It then moved the new cases into their own table. The full suite then showed 51 failures, and the visible one was an isSameOrigin assertion from the separate unimplemented spec. The owner said not to touch the same-origin tests for now. Nothing is merged or released yet.

milestones.text: Found joinURL appends to the raw base string, and that withTrailingSlash's respectQueryAndFragment option could be reused.
Patched joinURL to keep the base query and hash at the end and added five test cases. The run showed 5 of 55 failing.
Traced the remaining failures to joinRelativeURL, which has no query or hash awareness.
Moved the query and hash cases into their own table. The full suite then showed 51 failures, traced to the unimplemented isSameOrigin spec.

preferences.preference: Keep unrelated tests untouched while pushing a focused fix branch; defer them to the feature's implementation.
preferences.quote: Don't touch the same-origin tests right now, I'm pushing this branch for the joinURL fix; we'll sort them out when we implement it.
